title: NpcDef
description: The authored definition of one NPC (data, not behavior). Produced by the npc layer at author-time and embedded in the Adventure. `bodyRef` names an asset-registry character asset, which fixes the animation clips the body can actually perform.

persona.description: Public personality/summary the model speaks from.

knowledge.description: Private lore the NPC knows but does not volunteer.

relation.description: Allegiances/relationships to other entities, keyed loosely.

bodyRef.description: asset-registry character AssetEntry id. Its declared animations bound the allowedModes.

homeRoom.description: Room id this NPC belongs to.

voiceDesign.description: Deterministic voice parameters (ported from gamentic's voice-design composer).
